live.instructions:
An MCP server for accessing ICD-10-CM (diagnosis) and ICD-10-PCS (procedure) codes.

This server provides:
- Tools: Search codes by code number or description, validate codes, explore hierarchies
- Code types: ICD-10-CM for diagnoses, ICD-10-PCS for inpatient procedures
- Features: Full descriptions, billing validation, category exploration, body system navigation

ICD-10-CM codes are used for diagnosis coding in the United States healthcare system.
ICD-10-PCS codes are used for inpatient procedure coding.
This server uses the FY2027 code sets (in effect 2026-10-01 through 2027-09-30; ICD-10 updates every October 1, and some codes change mid-year). Tools accept an as_of date of service and report whether each code was in effect on that date (history from FY2020 for CM, FY2021 for PCS).

TOOL SELECTION GUIDE:
• lookup_code: Get details for a specific code when you know the exact code (e.g., 'E11.65', 'C92.11')
• search_codes: The unified search tool. Use it for:
    - Finding diagnosis codes by prefix (e.g., query='E11', code_type='diagnosis', search_by='code')
    - Finding diagnosis codes by description (e.g., query='diabetes', code_type='diagnosis')
    - Finding procedure codes by prefix (e.g., query='0DT', code_type='procedure', search_by='code')
    - Finding procedure codes by description (e.g., query='appendix', code_type='procedure')
• validate_code: Check if a code is valid and billable for HIPAA transactions
• get_chapter/get_category: Navigate code hierarchy to understand related codes

MULTI-TOOL WORKFLOWS:
For comprehensive diagnosis analysis:
1. Use search_codes (by description) to find relevant codes by disease name
2. Use lookup_code to get full details including billability status
3. Use get_category to understand related codes in the same family
4. For disease progression scenarios, look up related status codes

DISEASE PROGRESSION PATTERNS:
Many conditions have related codes for different stages - always look up the full set:
• Cancer: primary site codes, 'in remission' codes, 'relapse' codes (e.g., C92.10 → C92.11 → C92.12)
• Diabetes: codes with/without complications, type specification
• Heart disease: acute vs chronic phase codes
• Use search_codes (by code) with the base code prefix to find all related codes

tools.name: lookup_code
tools.title: Lookup ICD-10 Code
tools.description: Look up a specific ICD-10 code by its code number. Returns full details including descriptions, HIPAA transaction validity status, and the fiscal years the code has been in effect (FY2027 code set; history tracked from FY2020 for diagnosis, FY2021 for procedure). Pass as_of with the encounter's date of service to check the code was in effect on that date — ICD-10 sets change every October 1 and sometimes mid-year. Codes retired from the current set still resolve, marked with the last year or day they were in effect.

code.description: ICD-10 code to look up (e.g., 'E11.65' for diagnosis, '0DTJ4ZZ' for procedure).

code_type.description: 'diagnosis' (ICD-10-CM) or 'procedure' (ICD-10-PCS). Omit to auto-detect: CM is tried first, then PCS if the code is 7 alphanumeric characters.

as_of.description: Optional date of service (YYYY-MM-DD). ICD-10 code sets change every October 1, and some codes are added or deleted partway through a year (usually April 1): a code valid today may not have existed on the encounter date, and vice versa. When provided, the response reports whether the code was in effect on this date. Omit for current-set (FY2027) behavior.

found.description: Whether the code was found in the database

anyOf.description: Base model for ICD-10 codes.

code.description: ICD-10 code (e.g., 'E11.65' for diagnosis, '0DTJ4ZZ' for procedure)

short_description.description: Short description of the code (typically under 60 characters)

long_description.description: Full/detailed description of the code with complete clinical terminology

valid_for_hipaa_transactions.description: Whether this code is valid for HIPAA-covered transactions (True) or is a category header only (False). Only codes with True can be used for billing

first_fy.description: First CMS fiscal year this code was in effect. The history begins at FY2020 (diagnosis) and FY2021 (procedure), so a code whose first year is that one may be older

last_fy.description: Last CMS fiscal year this code was in effect (less than the current code-set year means the code has been retired)

as_of_note.description: Whether this code was in effect on the as_of date of service; from lookup_code, also whether it was billable on that date when that differs from valid_for_hipaa_transactions. Without as_of, set only for a retired code or one that took effect partway through a fiscal year

tools.name: search_codes
tools.title: Search ICD-10 Codes
tools.description: Search ICD-10-CM diagnosis and ICD-10-PCS procedure codes. Unified tool that supports searching by code or description. Use this for all ICD-10 search needs. Serves the FY2027 code set (in effect Oct 1 through Sep 30). Pass as_of with the encounter's date of service to annotate each result with whether it was in effect on that date — codes added after the date of service must not go on the claim.

query.description: The search query. Can be a code (e.g., 'E11.65', '0B1') or a description term (e.g., 'diabetes', 'appendectomy').

code_type.description: Type of codes to search: 'diagnosis' (ICD-10-CM) or 'procedure' (ICD-10-PCS).

search_by.description: Field to search: 'code' (exact or prefix) or 'description' (text search).

exact.description: If True, search for exact code match. If False, search by prefix. Only used when search_by='code'.

valid_for_hipaa_only.description: If True, only return codes valid for HIPAA transactions. Only used when search_by='description'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

as_of.description: Optional date of service (YYYY-MM-DD). ICD-10 code sets change every October 1, and some codes are added or deleted partway through a year (usually April 1): a code valid today may not have existed on the encounter date, and vice versa. When provided, the response reports whether the code was in effect on this date. Omit for current-set (FY2027) behavior.

tools.name: validate_code
tools.title: Validate ICD-10 Code
tools.description: Validate an ICD-10 code to check if it exists and is valid for HIPAA-covered transactions. Pass as_of with the encounter's date of service to also check the code was in effect on that date — ICD-10 sets change every October 1 and sometimes mid-year, and a code not in effect on the date of service is not billable (current set: FY2027). Codes retired from the current set are reported as retired, with the period they were in effect.

code.description: ICD-10 code to validate (e.g., 'E11.65' for diagnosis, '0DTJ4ZZ' for procedure).

code_type.description: 'diagnosis' (ICD-10-CM) or 'procedure' (ICD-10-PCS). Omit to auto-detect: CM is tried first, then PCS if the code is 7 alphanumeric characters.

as_of.description: Optional date of service (YYYY-MM-DD). ICD-10 code sets change every October 1, and some codes are added or deleted partway through a year (usually April 1): a code valid today may not have existed on the encounter date, and vice versa. When provided, the response reports whether the code was in effect on this date. Omit for current-set (FY2027) behavior.

code.description: The code that was validated

exists.description: Whether the code exists in the database

valid_for_hipaa_transactions.description: Whether the code is valid for HIPAA-covered transactions (not a category header). With as_of, judged as of that date if the code was in effect then and the date is in a tracked fiscal year; otherwise judged in the current code set (for a retired code, its last edition)

is_valid.description: True if the code exists, is valid for HIPAA transactions, and is in effect: on the as_of date when given (a date whose in-effect status the code history cannot settle counts as in effect), otherwise in the current code set

short_description.description: Short description of the code (if found)

tools.name: get_hierarchy
tools.title: Get Code Hierarchy
tools.description: Get the hierarchy of codes under a category. Returns the category header and up to `limit` child codes (default 500, max 2000) ordered by code; broad prefixes (e.g. a single-letter chapter) may be truncated. Use this to explore related codes within a disease category or code family.

code_prefix.description: Code prefix to get hierarchy for (e.g., 'E11' for Type 2 Diabetes)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: search_codes
tools.title: Search ICD-10 Codes
tools.description: Search ICD-10-CM diagnosis and ICD-10-PCS procedure codes. Unified tool that supports searching by code or description. Use this for all ICD-10 search needs. Serves the FY2027 code set (in effect Oct 1 through Sep 30). Pass as_of with the encounter's date of service to annotate each result with whether it was in effect on that date — codes added after the date of service must not go on the claim.

query.description: The search query. Can be a code (e.g., 'E11.65', '0B1') or a description term (e.g., 'diabetes', 'appendectomy').

code_type.description: Type of codes to search: 'diagnosis' (ICD-10-CM) or 'procedure' (ICD-10-PCS).

search_by.description: Field to search: 'code' (exact or prefix) or 'description' (text search).

exact.description: If True, search for exact code match. If False, search by prefix. Only used when search_by='code'.

valid_for_hipaa_only.description: If True, only return codes valid for HIPAA transactions. Only used when search_by='description'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

as_of.description: Optional date of service (YYYY-MM-DD). ICD-10 code sets change every October 1, and some codes are added or deleted partway through a year (usually April 1): a code valid today may not have existed on the encounter date, and vice versa. When provided, the response reports whether the code was in effect on this date. Omit for current-set (FY2027) behavior.

tools.name: validate_code
tools.title: Validate ICD-10 Code
tools.description: Validate an ICD-10 code to check if it exists and is valid for HIPAA-covered transactions. Pass as_of with the encounter's date of service to also check the code was in effect on that date — ICD-10 sets change every October 1 and sometimes mid-year, and a code not in effect on the date of service is not billable (current set: FY2027). Codes retired from the current set are reported as retired, with the period they were in effect.

code.description: ICD-10 code to validate (e.g., 'E11.65' for diagnosis, '0DTJ4ZZ' for procedure).

code_type.description: 'diagnosis' (ICD-10-CM) or 'procedure' (ICD-10-PCS). Omit to auto-detect: CM is tried first, then PCS if the code is 7 alphanumeric characters.

as_of.description: Optional date of service (YYYY-MM-DD). ICD-10 code sets change every October 1, and some codes are added or deleted partway through a year (usually April 1): a code valid today may not have existed on the encounter date, and vice versa. When provided, the response reports whether the code was in effect on this date. Omit for current-set (FY2027) behavior.

code.description: The code that was validated

exists.description: Whether the code exists in the database

valid_for_hipaa_transactions.description: Whether the code is valid for HIPAA-covered transactions (not a category header). With as_of, judged as of that date if the code was in effect then and the date is in a tracked fiscal year; otherwise judged in the current code set (for a retired code, its last edition)

is_valid.description: True if the code exists, is valid for HIPAA transactions, and is in effect: on the as_of date when given (a date whose in-effect status the code history cannot settle counts as in effect), otherwise in the current code set

short_description.description: Short description of the code (if found)
